note: What an errand COSTS, per world, in watt-hours (pluggybot issue #15).
DATA, not code, on exactly the terms economy/rewards.json and
economy/cadence.json are: this is a measurement about a world, it wants
re-deriving whenever the world or the errand changes, and a deploy has
to be able to re-point it on a mounted volume without a rebuild --
$PLUGGY_ENERGY=/path/to/energy.json.
MEASURED, NEVER GUESSED. scripts/energy_spike.py is where every number
below comes from: it flies each errand once on an oversized pack and
reports the span the mission loop cannot interrupt. A guessed 0.35 Wh
for a drawing that measured 0.93 once had a robot claim the job at 88 %
and die mid-stroke holding the pen.
WHERE TWO HONEST MEASUREMENTS DISAGREE, THE TABLE CARRIES THE DEARER.
An errand's cost depends on where the robot is standing when it starts,
and the gate's failure directions are not symmetric -- an over-estimate
is a charge the robot did not strictly need, an under-estimate is a
robot dead on the way back -- so the high reading wins.
errandWh       action -> Wh for the whole job. A key may also be
`action:target`, which wins over the bare action where
one target is further than another
defaultWh      what an action with no row costs. Omitted means 'the
dearest measured one here', which is the conservative
reading and the right one for an unpriced errand
exploreWhPerS  exploring is not an errand (it is bounded and
interruptible) but the rate is measured so a slice can
be priced in the overseer's prompt
chargeW        NET watts into the pack on the charger. The default
block's is the rover's slowest press (#376 deleted the
rover): lifecycle.charge_timeout catches a robot on pins
that conduct nothing, and sized off a good charge it
would fire on a slow one that is working
READ THE NUMBERS AGAINST THE PACK: the return-trip reserve is a property
of the floor plan (humanoid/world.py's RESERVE_WH), and an errand must
leave it in hand where the charged pack funds the dearest job plus the
reserve. A row is the trip OUT and the job, and the way home is what the
reserve funds -- measured from the house's worst place.
